content: Home Manager releases align with NixOS releases (release-26.05 branch targets current stable 26.05 and unstable). Standalone: home-manager.lib.homeManagerConfiguration { pkgs = nixpkgs.legacyPackages.; extraSpecialArgs = { inherit inputs; }; modules = [ ./home.nix ]; } → homeConfigurations.<name>. NixOS module: home-manager.nixosModules.home-manager with useGlobalPkgs/useUserPackages/extraSpecialArgs/users. Keep single nixpkgs: home-manager.inputs.nixpkgs.follows = "nixpkgs" (HM docs: removes HM-internal lockfile compat assumption; use carefully on unstable, fine on stable pair). extraSpecialArgs preferred over _module.args for values from outside module graph.
